lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for 'adoption, redesign', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', 'sign_in, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as their tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests.
No kind of change can be called helpful yet, as no tests have won.
Predictions have mostly been too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7 and 8 were underestimated.

candidates.title: choose_path_two_column_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen into a two-column layout with a playful mascot visual preview alongside path descriptions.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a 23.8% drop-off and a long mean completion time of 514s, showing hesitation during path selection.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion Path
choose_path.body: Select how you want your companion to interact with your desktop daily.

guard.reason: Redesigning the choose_path screen layout while maintaining its function inside onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Targets choose_path hesitation, but redesigns have shown no positive lift historically.

candidates.title: pet_interaction_tutorial_screen
candidates.change: Add a new tutorial screen at the end of onboarding that walks through dragging, right-clicking, and hiding the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support receives frequent complaints about users not knowing how to control, hide, or interact with their pet after setup.

new_pet_interaction_tutorial.headline: How to Interact With Your Desktop Companion
new_pet_interaction_tutorial.body: Master essential desktop pet gestures before jumping in.

components.text: Right-click your pet anytime for actions and settings menu
Click and drag to position your pet anywhere on your screen

guard.reason: Adding a new tutorial screen after home_intro at the end of onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong funnel and support evidence, but adding a new screen historically yielded -0.4% lift.

candidates.title: photo_upload_quality_guidance_flow
candidates.change: Introduce photo quality guidelines and tip carousels during pet photo upload to prevent corrupted pet generation.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops significantly to 60.9%, and support received multiple reports of custom pet generation failing or rendering wrong.

upload_photos.headline: Upload High-Quality Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Clear, well-lit photos ensure your custom pet renders cleanly on your desktop.

components.text: Avoid blurry photos or heavy shadows for best results

guard.reason: Adding photo quality guidance carousels and tips within the photo upload step is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Largest drop-off step with strong support complaints, but new_flow tested -0.7% lift.

candidates.title: sign_in_reorder_after_pick_friend
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur right after picking a friend companion, before starting photo uploads or certificates.
candidates.why: Asking users to sign in before choosing a pet causes a 27.1% drop-off; picking a pet first builds commitment.

guard.reason: Reordering the sign-in step inside onboarding is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in previously led to a severe -6.6% relative performance drop.

candidates.title: adoption_certificate_two_column_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a two-column layout with a verified companion stamp badge.
candidates.why: Adoption is the biggest drop-off point in the funnel (60.9% conversion); making the completion moment official boosts motivation.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Review your companion's official record to finalize adoption.

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.official_stamp' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'badge', 'image'] with an asset:stamp/ asset

candidates.title: waiting_screen_interactive_tips
candidates.change: Display progress indicators, time estimates, and desktop usage tips on the waiting screen while the pet initializes.
candidates.why: The waiting stage has a median duration of 201s and a mean of 2336s, causing users to drop off if they believe the app has frozen.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Arrival
waiting.body: Setting up your companion's desktop environment.

components.text: Tip: You can hide or mute your pet anytime from the tray menu.

guard.reason: Adding progress indicators, estimates, and tips to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean waiting duration (2336s) by providing interactive progress info.

candidates.title: choose_path_reassurance_hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint explaining that the path selection can be re-configured anytime in app settings.
candidates.why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, showing user indecision due to fear of making an irreversible choice.

choose_path.hint: You can change your companion's path and personality settings anytime later.

guard.reason: Adding reassuring hints to the path selection screen inside onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Config-only hint mitigating user hesitation at choose_path due to perceived commitment.

candidates.title: sign_in_account_persistence_copy
candidates.change: Add sign-in body copy emphasizing using the same account method to avoid account duplication or pet loss.
candidates.why: Support logged 8 emails about pets missing or reset after users signed in again with a different login method.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Companion
sign_in.body: Use your primary sign-in method so your pet data and progress stay synced across sessions.
sign_in.hint: Already adopted a pet? Sign in with the same account to restore your companion.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to clarify account syncing inside onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy change directly targeting 8 support emails regarding lost pets.

candidates.title: home_intro_desktop_launch_copy
candidates.change: Update the home intro text to give explicit directions on where the pet appears on screen and how to click it.
candidates.why: Finish step drops off to 64.8% and support receives issues regarding pets not appearing or users failing to open/find them.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Now on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look around your screen! Your pet is active. Click and drag to position them anywhere, or right-click to open actions.

guard.reason: Updating text copy on the home_intro overlay is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Config copy update supported by high finish drop-off (35.2%) and explicit support reports.

candidates.title: pick_friend_starter_accessory_incentive
candidates.change: Add a starter accessory badge on the pet selection screen offering free bonus items for adopting today.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%) across the entire onboarding funnel.

pick_friend.headline: Pick Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Choose a friend to receive complimentary starter items and toys.

guard.reason: text in 'pick_friend.body' talks about price or money

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for 'adoption, redesign', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', 'sign_in, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as their tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
